questions.question: What is a galaxy?
choices: A single planet and its atmosphere
A gravitationally bound system of stars, gas, dust, and dark matter
One isolated comet
A constellation drawn on a sky chart

questions.question: What type of galaxy is the Milky Way?
choices: A single giant star
A globular cluster only
A barred spiral galaxy
An elliptical galaxy without a disk

questions.question: What does a light-year measure?
choices: Time alone
Luminosity
Mass
Distance

questions.question: What is a galaxy cluster?
choices: A group of galaxies bound by gravity
A set of planets around one star
A region containing only one atom
A pattern of bright stars near Earth

questions.question: What is cosmological redshift?
choices: Shortening of wavelengths due to large-scale expansion
Stretching of light wavelengths associated with the expansion of space
A change in brightness with no change in wavelength
Absorption of only red wavelengths by intergalactic material

questions.question: What is the cosmic microwave background?
choices: Radio signals sent by planets
Heat emitted only by Earth's oceans
Relic radiation from the early universe
Light from one nearby supernova

questions.question: What is dark matter?
choices: A name for any black-colored rock
Matter that has no gravitational effect
Ordinary dust hidden only behind the Moon
Matter inferred mainly from gravitational effects rather than its light

questions.question: Why do observations of distant galaxies show them as they were in the past?
choices: Their light takes time to reach Earth
Distant light arrives instantaneously despite its distance
Telescopes alter the age of the source
Every galaxy has stopped emitting new light

questions.question: What does the Big Bang model describe?
choices: Only the formation of our Solar System
Evolution from an early hot, dense universe that has expanded
A recent chemical explosion at the universe's center
A universe that has always had the same temperature and density

questions.question: Why is the microwave background important evidence for the Big Bang model?
choices: It proves all galaxies have identical stellar populations
It is produced entirely by Earth's atmosphere
It matches expectations for cooled radiation from an early hot universe
It shows that all space has always been cold

questions.question: What pattern supports large-scale expansion of the universe?
choices: Every galaxy has the same measured redshift
All galaxies become brighter in proportion to their distance
Every galaxy orbits the Sun at the same speed
More distant galaxies generally show greater cosmological redshift

questions.question: Why is a constellation different from a galaxy?
choices: It is a sky pattern of stars that may be far apart
It is a gravitationally bound cluster of many galaxies
It is one stellar system containing planets around a single star
It is a rotating cloud of gas that has no stars

questions.question: Why do astronomers infer dark matter in many galaxies?
choices: Visible stars alone always account for all observed motion
Visible matter alone cannot explain some observed gravitational motions
Dark matter is identified only by a galaxy's dark photograph
Any faint region must contain no mass

questions.question: What is dark energy associated with in current cosmological models?
choices: The gravitational slowing of expansion as its only effect
The energy emitted only by white dwarfs
The accelerated expansion of the universe
The motion of planets within our Solar System

questions.question: Why can galaxies collide even though the universe expands on large scales?
choices: Expansion forces all gravitationally bound objects to separate
Galaxies cannot attract each other gravitationally
Galaxy collisions require Earth to lie between them
Local gravitational attraction can overcome the large-scale expansion

questions.question: Light from a galaxy has traveled for 5 million years. What does the observation show?
choices: The galaxy as it was about 5 million years ago
The galaxy exactly as it is now
The galaxy 5 million years in the future
The galaxy before any light existed

questions.question: A spectral line emitted at 500 nm is observed at 550 nm. How is this shift described?
choices: Blueshift
Redshift
No wavelength change
A change into a sound wave

questions.question: Two galaxies lie far outside our local gravitational group. The farther one has greater redshift. Which model is this consistent with?
choices: A static universe with no change in light wavelength
All galaxies orbiting the Milky Way at identical speeds
Large-scale expansion of space
Light wavelengths shortening as space expands

questions.question: A galaxy's outer stars move faster than expected from its visible matter alone. What should scientists investigate?
choices: Whether the observed velocities must equal zero
Whether the visible mass alone has already explained all motion
Whether star brightness directly measures speed without a model
Additional gravitating matter and alternative explanations of the motion

questions.question: A student claims a light-year is the age of a star. What is the appropriate correction?
choices: It is the distance light travels in a year
It is a unit of a star's temperature
It is a unit of a star's mass
It is the time between two supernovae
